title: Severe bleeding
reference: NASA Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TCCC) in Spaceflight & ISS Trauma Management Guidelines.

q1.text: Is there catastrophic arterial bleeding (pulsatile spurting, blood pooling rapidly in microgravity air globules)?

i_tourniquet.text: IMMEDIATE TOURNIQUET APPLICATION: Place Combat Application Tourniquet (CAT) 2–3 inches proximal to wound (not over a joint). Turn windlass rod until bleeding stops and distal pulse vanishes. Lock rod.

t_tourn.text: Assess distal limb perfusion and verify complete cessation of arterial bleeding over 3 minutes.

q_tourn_check.text: Has the distal arterial bleeding completely stopped after tourniquet tightening?

i_tourn_ok.text: TOURNIQUET SECURED: Mark exact Zulu time on patient forehead (e.g., T-14:30Z). Apply sterile protective dressing over wound. DO NOT LOOSEN TOURNIQUET.

i_tourn_fail.text: SECOND TOURNIQUET: Apply a second CAT tourniquet directly proximal to the first. Tighten fully. Pack wound cavity with additional hemostatic gauze.

q2.text: Is the bleeding non-arterial but continuous and soaking through pressure dressings?

i_pack.text: HEMOSTATIC WOUND PACKING: Pack wound tightly with QuikClot / Celox hemostatic gauze directly against bone/bleeding vessel. Apply firm manual pressure.

t_pressure.text: Maintain uninterrupted direct compression on wound for 3 full minutes without lifting dressings to inspect.

q_pack_check.text: After 3 minutes of firm manual pressure, has hemorrhage ceased without strike-through?

i_pack_ok.text: Apply elastic compression wrap (Israeli bandage) firmly over hemostatic pack. Check distal pulse and capillary refill.

i_pack_fail.text: Apply proximal arterial compression and escalate to extremity tourniquet if applicable.

q3.text: Is the wound a minor laceration or abrasion with controlled venous oozing?

i_minor_lac.text: MINOR LACERATION: Irrigate thoroughly with sterile saline pouch; approximate wound edges with sterile Steri-Strips or surgical tissue adhesive (Dermabond); apply sterile dressing.

i_puncture.text: PUNCTURE / EMBEDDED OBJECT: Do not remove penetrating object. Stabilize object with bulky rolled dressings and secure firmly.

end_monitor.text: Wound debrided and dressed. Monitor dressing every 4 hours for re-bleeding; evaluate need for prophylactic antibiotic.

end_escalate.text: HEMORRHAGIC TRAUMA ESCALATION: Flight Surgeon active on emergency comms. Prepare IV fluid resuscitation line (Normal Saline / Tranexamic Acid TXA).
